title: Declarative package model and execution planning
summary: integration.json decodes into ooRexx package/domain objects. Exact dependencies are resolved before execution, and the planner produces immutable-ish per-test plans with exact cwd, argv, timeout and environment.
invariants: A package identity is name@version; dependency references are exact.
Unresolved exact dependencies fail planning before test execution.
Environment precedence is base/caller, resolved dependencies, package environment, then individual test environment.
Test-level REXX_PATH may prepend, append or replace earlier entries without changing other tests in the same package.
integration.json is decoded by the model; the executor consumes model objects rather than interpreting JSON itself.

provenance.claim: Exact dependency resolution and environment composition.
integration.json codec maps manifest into domain objects.
